title: Acrylic Paint Set, 12 Pots x 60 ml, Matte Finish for Canvas and Wood
description:
Rich, creamy acrylic paints in easy-pour pots for canvas, wood, cardboard, stones and papier-mâché. Colours mix well and dry to a smooth matte finish.
• Contents: 12 pots x 60 ml in primary, earth and bright shades plus black and white
• Water-based and low-odour; brushes clean with soap and water
• Dries to the touch in about 20–30 minutes and is water-resistant once dry
• Screw lids keep paint fresh between sessions
• Ages 8+; not for use on skin

title: Watercolour Paint Set, 36 Half Pans with 4 Brushes in a Metal Tin
description:
A portable watercolour set for sketching outdoors, journaling and learning to paint. The half pans re-wet quickly and give bright, layerable washes.
• Contents: 36 half pans of watercolour, 4 round brushes (sizes 0, 2, 4 and 6)
• Metal tin with a fold-out lid that doubles as a mixing palette
• Tin size: approx. 20 x 10 x 2 cm
• Pans can be replaced individually when used up

title: Artist Paint Brush Set, 15 Brushes with Synthetic Bristles
description:
A versatile brush set for acrylic, watercolour, gouache and oil painting, with shapes for broad washes, fine lines and details.
• Contents: 15 brushes in round, flat, filbert, angled and fan shapes
• Soft synthetic bristles that hold their shape and rinse clean easily
• Wooden handles with seamless nickel-plated ferrules
• Lengths from approx. 17 to 21 cm; comes in a roll-up storage pouch

title: Coloured Pencils, 36 Colours in a Canvas Pencil Roll
description:
Soft-core coloured pencils that blend and layer smoothly, packed in a canvas roll that keeps every colour in view and protects the tips.
• Contents: 36 coloured pencils and a canvas roll with individual elastic slots
• Pencils: 17.5 cm long with 3.3 mm break-resistant leads
• Pre-sharpened; suitable for colouring books, sketching and school projects
• Roll closes with a fabric tie; size approx. 30 x 20 cm open
• Ages 6+

title: Sewing Kit, 98 Pieces with Threads, Needles, Scissors and Tape Measure
description:
Everything you need for quick repairs and small sewing projects at home, in the office or when travelling, organised in a zipped case.
• Includes: 24 thread spools, 30 hand-sewing needles, 30 pins, safety pins and buttons
• Tools: small fabric scissors, 150 cm tape measure, thimble, needle threader and seam ripper
• Zipped storage case with elastic loops, approx. 20 x 14 x 5 cm
• Suitable for beginners and occasional sewing

title: Acrylic Yarn Bundle, 12 Balls x 50 g for Knitting and Crochet
description:
Soft, easy-care acrylic yarn in a bundle of coordinating colours, ideal for blankets, amigurumi toys, scarves and beginner projects.
• Contents: 12 balls x 50 g, approx. 100 m per ball (1,200 m in total)
• Weight: double knit (DK), recommended needle and hook size 4–4.5 mm
• 100% acrylic; machine-washable at 30 °C
• Choose from three colour mixes

title: Crochet Hook Set, 14 Sizes 2–10 mm with Soft-Grip Handles
description:
A complete set of crochet hooks for thin cotton thread through to chunky yarn, with ergonomic handles that are comfortable for long sessions.
• Sizes: 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6, 6.5, 7, 8, 9 and 10 mm
• Smooth aluminium hooks with colour-coded soft rubber handles
• Size marked on every handle
• Includes a zipped fabric case, 10 locking stitch markers and a darning needle

title: Aluminium Knitting Needles Set, 11 Pairs 2–8 mm with Stitch Markers
description:
Lightweight straight knitting needles in all the common sizes, so you are ready for socks, jumpers, scarves and chunky blankets.
• 11 pairs: 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6, 7 and 8 mm
• Length: 35 cm; anodised aluminium with smooth tapered tips
• Includes 20 heart-shaped stitch markers and 2 row counters
• Stored in a roll-up fabric case

title: Junk Journal Kit with A5 Notebook, Patterned Papers, Stickers and Twine
description:
A ready-to-start kit for creating a memory book or travel journal, combining a blank notebook with papers and embellishments to layer and collage.
• Includes: A5 kraft notebook with 60 blank pages, 40 patterned papers and 20 vellum and tag pieces
• Embellishments: 100 stickers, 4 washi tapes, paper clips and 5 m of jute twine
• Botanical and vintage-style designs that mix and match
• Packed in a reusable gift box

title: Vintage Scrapbook Paper Pack, 60 Sheets with Ephemera Designs
description:
Aged-look papers with old letters, maps, botanical prints and music sheets for scrapbooks, junk journals, card making and decoupage.
• Contents: 60 sheets in 30 designs (2 of each)
• Size: 15 x 21 cm; printed on one side on 120 gsm paper
• Acid-free paper that is easy to cut, tear, fold and glue
• Works with glue sticks, double-sided tape and decoupage glue

title: Wooden Rubber Stamp Set, 24 Doodle Designs with Black Ink Pad
description:
Charming doodle stamps on solid wooden blocks for decorating cards, planners, gift tags and scrapbook pages.
• Contents: 24 wooden stamps (approx. 2.5–4 cm) and 1 black ink pad
• Designs include plants, animals, weather icons, arrows and frames
• Natural rubber stamping surface for clean, crisp prints
• Water-based ink pad; stamps clean with a damp cloth

title: Letter Bead Bracelet Kit, 1,200 Pieces with Elastic Cord
description:
Make name bracelets, friendship bracelets and bag charms with this colourful bead kit, sorted in a clear box with a compartment for every style.
• Contents: approx. 1,200 beads, including white alphabet cubes, heart beads and coloured seed beads
• Includes 2 rolls of clear elastic cord (0.8 mm, 10 m each) and a bead needle
• Storage box with 24 compartments, approx. 22 x 11 x 2 cm
• Ages 6+. Warning: small parts, not suitable for children under 3 years

title: Mixed Acrylic Beads Set in Compartment Box, 24 Shapes and Colours
description:
A cheerful assortment of round, faceted and patterned beads for bracelets, necklaces, keyrings and kids' craft projects.
• Contents: approx. 600 acrylic beads, 6–12 mm, in 24 shapes and colours
• Large 2 mm holes that are easy to thread on cord or elastic
• Lightweight plastic beads with a glossy finish
• Reusable box with 24 compartments
• Ages 6+. Warning: small parts, not suitable for children under 3 years

title: Glass Seed Beads 3 mm, 24 Colours, approx. 6,000 Beads
description:
Small, uniform glass seed beads for jewellery making, bead embroidery and loom work, sorted by colour.
• Size: 3 mm (8/0) with 1 mm holes
• Contents: approx. 6,000 beads in 24 opaque and transparent colours
• Comes in a box of 24 lidded tubs to keep colours separate
• Ages 14+. Warning: small parts, not suitable for children under 3 years

title: Mini Hot Glue Gun 20 W with 30 Glue Sticks, EU Plug
description:
A compact hot glue gun for crafts, decorations, quick repairs and school projects. It bonds paper, card, fabric, wood, foam and plastics.
• Power: 20 W, heats up in about 3–5 minutes; EU plug, 1.2 m cable
• Takes 7 mm glue sticks; 30 clear sticks (10 cm) included
• Fold-out metal stand and on/off switch with indicator light
• Insulated nozzle; for ages 14+, children only with adult supervision

title: Craft Pom Poms, 300 Pieces in Mixed Colours and Sizes
description:
Soft, fluffy pom poms for kids' crafts, greeting cards, garlands and classroom projects. They glue easily onto paper, felt and card.
• Contents: 300 pom poms in 10 bright colours
• Sizes: 10 mm, 15 mm, 20 mm and 25 mm
• Made of soft polyester fibre
• Ages 3+. Warning: small parts, not suitable for children under 3 years

title: Origami Paper, 200 Sheets 15 x 15 cm in 20 Vivid Colours
description:
Thin, crisp folding paper that holds a sharp crease, perfect for cranes, flowers, boxes and paper animals.
• Contents: 200 sheets in 20 colours (10 sheets per colour)
• Size: 15 x 15 cm; 70 gsm paper, coloured on both sides
• Includes a fold-out guide with 10 beginner models
• Also suitable for card making and collage; ages 6+

title: Embroidery Starter Kit with Floral Pattern, Wooden Hoop and Threads
description:
Learn hand embroidery with a pre-printed floral design: just follow the printed lines and the colour guide to stitch your own wall decoration.
• Includes: printed cotton fabric, 20 cm bamboo hoop, pre-sorted coloured threads and 3 needles
• Illustrated instructions with 8 basic stitches and a colour key
• Finished design can be displayed in the hoop
• Suitable for beginners aged 12+

title: Macrame Wall Hanging Kit with Cotton Cord and Wooden Dowel
description:
Knot your own boho wall hanging in an afternoon. The kit includes pre-measured cord and step-by-step instructions for beginners.
• Includes: 60 m of natural 4 mm cotton cord, 30 cm wooden dowel and a hanging string
• Printed guide with the basic square, spiral and half-hitch knots
• Finished size: approx. 30 x 55 cm
• Comb and scissors not included

title: Soy Wax Candle Making Kit with 4 Amber Glass Jars and Wicks
description:
Pour your own container candles at home. The kit contains the wax, wicks and jars you need for four candles, plus a pouring jug and clear instructions.
• Includes: 500 g soy wax flakes, 4 amber glass jars (200 ml) with lids and 8 cotton wicks with metal bases
• Also included: aluminium pouring jug, wick centring bars, wick stickers and 6 colour dye chips
• Melts on a stovetop using a water bath (pan not included)
• Ages 14+; adult supervision required when working with hot wax
